00050|  * Extract transcript from OpenCode JSON output.
00051|  * When run with --format json, OpenCode outputs JSON events to stdout.
00052|  * Preserved verbatim from the old adapter.
00053|  *
00054|  * @param {string|undefined|null} output
00055|  * @returns {string|undefined}
00056|  */
00057| export function extractTranscriptFromOutput(output) {
00058|   if (!output || !output.trim()) {
00059|     return undefined;
00060|   }
00061| 
00062|   // The --format json output contains JSON events, one per line.
00063|   // Filter to only include lines that look like JSON objects.
00064|   const lines = output.split('\n').filter((line) => {
00065|     const trimmed = line.trim();
00066|     return trimmed.startsWith('{') && trimmed.endsWith('}');
00067|   });
00068| 
00069|   if (lines.length === 0) {
00070|     return undefined;
00071|   }
00072| 
00073|   return lines.join('\n');
00074| }
00075| 
00076| /**
00077|  * Scrape the OpenCode printed logs for the primary build model.
00078|  * Works on OpenCode <= 1.16.x, whose INFO log lines carry providerID/modelID.
00079|  * Preserved verbatim from the old adapter.
00080|  *
00081|  * @param {string} output
00082|  * @returns {string|undefined}
00083|  */
00084| export function extractObservedModelFromOpenCodeOutput(output) {
00085|   let observedModel;
00086| 
00087|   for (const line of output.split('\n')) {
00088|     if (!line.includes('service=llm') || !line.includes('small=false') || !line.includes('agent=build')) {
00089|       continue;
00090|     }
00091| 
00092|     const providerMatch = line.match(/providerID=([^\s]+)/);
00093|     const modelMatch = line.match(/modelID=([^\s]+)/);
00094|     const providerID = providerMatch?.[1];
00095|     const modelID = modelMatch?.[1];
00096|     if (providerID && modelID) {
00097|       observedModel = `${providerID}/${modelID}`;
00098|     }
00099|   }
00100| 
00101|   return observedModel;
00102| }
00103| 
00104| /**
00105|  * Extract the session id from the `--format json` event stream.
00106|  * Every emitted event carries a `sessionID` field.
00107|  * Preserved verbatim from the old adapter.
00108|  *
00109|  * @param {string|undefined} transcript
00110|  * @returns {string|undefined}
00111|  */
00112| export function extractSessionIdFromTranscript(transcript) {
00113|   if (!transcript) {
00114|     return undefined;
00115|   }
00116| 
00117|   for (const line of transcript.split('\n')) {
00118|     try {
00119|       const event = JSON.parse(line);
00120|       if (typeof event.sessionID === 'string' && event.sessionID) {
00121|         return event.sessionID;
00122|       }
00123|     } catch {
00124|       // Skip non-JSON lines
00125|     }
00126|   }
00127| 
00128|   return undefined;
00129| }
00130| 
00131| /**
00132|  * Extract the observed model from `opencode export <sessionID>` output.
00133|  * Assistant messages carry `providerID` and `modelID` in their info.
00134|  * Preserved verbatim from the old adapter.
00135|  *
00136|  * @param {string} exportOutput
00137|  * @returns {string|undefined}
00138|  */
00139| export function extractObservedModelFromSessionExport(exportOutput) {
00140|   const start = exportOutput.indexOf('{');
00141|   if (start === -1) {
00142|     return undefined;
00143|   }
00144| 
00145|   let parsed;
00146|   try {
00147|     parsed = JSON.parse(exportOutput.slice(start));
00148|   } catch {
00149|     return undefined;
00150|   }
00151| 
00152|   const messages = parsed.messages;
00153|   if (!Array.isArray(messages)) {
00154|     return undefined;
00155|   }
00156| 
00157|   for (const message of messages) {
00158|     const info = message.info;
00159|     if (info?.role !== 'assistant') {
00160|       continue;
00161|     }
00162|     if (
00163|       typeof info.providerID === 'string' && info.providerID &&
00164|       typeof info.modelID === 'string' && info.modelID
00165|     ) {
00166|       return `${info.providerID}/${info.modelID}`;
00167|     }
00168|   }
00169| 
00170|   return undefined;
00171| }
00172| 
00173| /**
00174|  * Run OpenCode over the workspace at `input.cwd` and return a RunnerResult.
00175|  *
00176|  * Auth (AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY, and OPENCODE_ENABLE_EXA when web research is on)
00177|  * arrives via process.env — the orchestrator sets it on the `node run.mjs`
00178|  * invocation, and we pass process.env straight through to the CLI. The runner
00179|  * never handles secrets itself.
00180|  *
00181|  * @param {import('../plugin/contract.js').AgentRunInput} input
00182|  * @returns {Promise<import('../plugin/contract.js').RunnerResult>}
00183|  */
00184| export async function runAgent(input) {
00185|   const args = buildOpenCodeCliArgs(input);
00186| 
00187|   // spawnSync (not a shell string): the prompt is a plain argv element, so there
00188|   // is no shell quoting/escaping to get wrong. Blocking is fine — the runner has
00189|   // nothing else to do while the agent works. The sandbox-level timeout bounds it.
00190|   const res = spawnSync('opencode', args, {
00191|     cwd: input.cwd,
00192|     env: process.env,
00193|     encoding: 'utf8',
00194|     maxBuffer: 64 * 1024 * 1024,
00195|   });
00196| 
00197|   const stdout = res.stdout || '';
00198|   const stderr = res.stderr || '';
00199|   // Preserve the old concatenation order: stdout THEN stderr.
00200|   const output = stdout + stderr;
00201|   // spawnSync sets status=null + error when the binary can't be spawned at all.
00202|   const agentExitCode = res.status == null ? -1 : res.status;
00203| 
00204|   // Capture the transcript from the combined output (old: over stdout+stderr).
00205|   const transcript = extractTranscriptFromOutput(output) ?? null;
00206| 
00207|   // Resolve the model OpenCode actually used. The `--format json` events never
00208|   // include it, so first try scraping the printed logs (works on OpenCode <=
00209|   // 1.16.x), then fall back to `opencode export <sessionID>`, whose assistant
00210|   // messages carry providerID/modelID (OpenCode 1.17.0 changed the log format,
00211|   // which broke the scrape). Observation must never fail the run.
00212|   let observedModel = extractObservedModelFromOpenCodeOutput(output);
00213|   if (!observedModel) {
00214|     const sessionId = extractSessionIdFromTranscript(transcript ?? undefined);
00215|     if (sessionId) {
00216|       try {
00217|         const exportRes = spawnSync('opencode', ['export', sessionId], {
00218|           cwd: input.cwd,
00219|           env: process.env,
00220|           encoding: 'utf8',
00221|           maxBuffer: 64 * 1024 * 1024,
00222|         });
00223|         if ((exportRes.status == null ? -1 : exportRes.status) === 0) {
00224|           observedModel = extractObservedModelFromSessionExport(exportRes.stdout || '');
00225|         }
00226|       } catch {
00227|         // Leave observedModel undefined.
00228|       }
00229|     }
00230|   }
00231|   const observedModelOrNull = observedModel ?? null;
00232| 
00233|   if (res.error || agentExitCode !== 0) {
00234|     // Mirror the old error string: last 5 lines of output, else a coded fallback.
00235|     const errorLines = output.trim().split('\n').slice(-5).join('\n');
00236|     const fallback = res.error
00237|       ? `Failed to run opencode: ${res.error.message}`
00238|       : `OpenCode CLI exited with code ${agentExitCode}`;
00239|     return {
00240|       ok: false,
00241|       output,
00242|       transcript,
00243|       observedModel: observedModelOrNull,
00244|       error: errorLines || fallback,
00245|       agentExitCode,
00246|     };
00247|   }
00248| 
00249|   return {
00250|     ok: true,
00251|     output,
00252|     transcript,
00253|     observedModel: observedModelOrNull,
00254|     error: null,
00255|     agentExitCode,
00256|   };
00257| }
00258| 
00259| /* ─────────────────────────── runnable (CLI) entry ─────────────────────────── */
00260| 
00261| // True when this file is executed directly (`node run.mjs ...`), false when imported.
00262| const isMain = process.argv[1] && fileURLToPath(import.meta.url) === process.argv[1];
00263| 
00264| if (isMain) {
00265|   // argv[2] is the AgentRunInput JSON (never contains secrets).
00266|   const input = JSON.parse(process.argv[2]);
00267| 
00268|   // Always produce a RunnerResult, even if the runner itself throws, so the host
00269|   // always has a result file to read (node exit code stays 0 except on a truly
00270|   // unrecoverable crash before we can write).
00271|   let result;
00272|   try {
00273|     result = await runAgent(input);
00274|   } catch (e) {
00275|     result = {
00276|       ok: false,
00277|       output: '',
00278|       transcript: null,
00279|       observedModel: null,
00280|       error: e && e.message ? e.message : String(e),
00281|       agentExitCode: -1,
00282|     };
00283|   }
00284| 
00285|   // Source of truth: the result file the host reads back via sandbox.readFile.
00286|   try {
00287|     mkdirSync(dirname(input.resultPath), { recursive: true });
00288|     writeFileSync(input.resultPath, JSON.stringify(result));
00289|   } catch {
00290|     // If the file can't be written, the host falls back to the marker line below.
00291|   }
00292| 
00293|   // Fallback channel: a compact status line (no transcript — it can be huge).
00294|   process.stdout.write(
00295|     '__AGENT_RESULT__ ' +
00296|       JSON.stringify({
00297|         ok: result.ok,
00298|         observedModel: result.observedModel,
00299|         error: result.error,
00300|         agentExitCode: result.agentExitCode,
00301|       }) +
00302|       '\n'
00303|   );
00304| 
00305|   // Exit 0: "the runner ran". Agent success/failure is conveyed via result.ok, not
00306|   // the node exit code (the host distinguishes the two).
00307|   process.exit(0);
00308| }

 * The pure helpers below are exported (not just `runAgent`) so they can be
